subject: mathematics
question_text: If ω is a complex cube root of 1, then show that the determinant with rows (1, ω, ω²), (ω, ω², 1) and (ω², 1, ω) is 0.

mark_split.label: Add all three columns into C₁

recall_prompt: Say how you would do this one — name each move in order.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Add all three columns into C₁
steps.margin_note: First mark. Every row sums to 1 + ω + ω², because ω³ = 1 collapses every higher power back into the same three values.
lines: C₁ → C₁ + C₂ + C₃. Each row of C₁ becomes
— the same sum in every row.

recall.must_convey: That adding the three columns makes every entry of column 1 equal to 1 + ω + ω².
accept: add the three columns and every row gives one plus omega plus omega squared
each row sums to the same thing
the first column becomes identical in all three rows
moodu columns kalipithe anni rows same sum ichhai
heard_as: one plus omega plus omega squared

steps.why: The rows are cyclic rotations of each other, so they all contain the same three entries in different orders, and a sum does not depend on the order.
common_mistakes: Expanding the determinant directly and getting lost in powers of ω.

steps.label: Use 1 + ω + ω² = 0
steps.margin_note: Second mark. That sum is zero for a complex cube root of 1 — so column 1 is entirely zero, and a determinant with a zero column is zero.
lines: For a complex cube root of unity, 1 + ω + ω² = 0.
So every entry of C₁ is 0.
A determinant with a whole column of zeros is 0.

recall.must_convey: That 1 + ω + ω² = 0 makes column 1 all zeros, so the determinant is 0.
accept: one plus omega plus omega squared is zero so the whole column is zero and the determinant is zero
a determinant with a zero column is zero
the standard result makes the column vanish
aa sum zero kabatti column zero, determinant zero

steps.why: 1 + ω + ω² = 0 holds for the COMPLEX cube roots but not for ω = 1 — which is why the question says complex, and why that word is not decoration.
common_mistakes: Using ω = 1, for which the sum is 3 and the result fails.
Expanding after the operation instead of quoting the zero-column rule.
